steps.run:
ls -la ../2307-mc43-prev3/mc43.blend; cat > stills.py <<'EOF_ST'
# MC43 all-Blender stills from the saved full scene (work/2307-mc43-prev3/mc43.blend).
# Run: Blender -b mc43.blend -P stills.py -- OUTDIR S E      (S..E = indices into FR below)
# Per still: a 25 % / 4-sample probe measures mean luminance and sets the exposure so the frame sits around mid-grey,
# a soft fill light rides on the camera (lifts faces/figures out of silhouette), then the final still renders at
# 100 % / 16 samples and is saved as JPEG 95.
import bpy, sys, os, math, time
import numpy as np
argv = sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--") + 1:]
OUT = os.path.abspath(argv[0]); S, E = int(argv[1]), int(argv[2])
FR = [int(x) for x in os.environ.get("MC_FRAMES", "").split(",") if x]
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
sc = bpy.context.scene
ee = sc.eevee
ims = sc.render.image_settings
try: ims.media_type = "IMAGE"
except Exception: pass
try: bpy.context.preferences.system.gl_texture_limit = "CLAMP_2048"
except Exception: pass
# camera fill: soft area light parented to the active camera
cam = sc.camera
ld = bpy.data.lights.new("mc_fill", "AREA"); ld.energy = 220; ld.size = 2.5; ld.color = (1.0, 0.93, 0.86)
try: ld.use_shadow = False
except Exception: pass
fl = bpy.data.objects.new("mc_fill", ld); sc.collection.objects.link(fl)
def place_fill():
    c = sc.camera
    if c is None: return
    fl.matrix_world = c.matrix_world.copy()
    fl.location = c.matrix_world @ __import__("mathutils").Vector((0.9, 0.6, 0.3))
base_exp = sc.view_settings.exposure
for i in range(S, min(E, len(FR) - 1) + 1):
    f = FR[i]
    out = os.path.join(OUT, "s%04d.jpg" % f)
    if os.path.exists(out) and os.path.getsize(out) > 1000: continue
    t0 = time.time()
    sc.frame_set(f); place_fill()
    # probe
    sc.view_settings.exposure = base_exp
    sc.render.resolution_percentage = 25
    try: ee.taa_render_samples = 4
    except Exception: pass
    ims.file_format = "PNG"
    pp = os.path.join(OUT, "_probe_%d.png" % f); sc.render.filepath = pp
    bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
    im = bpy.data.images.load(pp); a = np.empty(im.size[0] * im.size[1] * 4, dtype=np.float32); im.pixels.foreach_get(a)
    a = a.reshape(-1, 4)[:, :3]; lum = float((0.2126 * a[:, 0] + 0.7152 * a[:, 1] + 0.0722 * a[:, 2]).mean())
    bpy.data.images.remove(im)
    gain = 0.0 if lum <= 1e-4 else math.log2(0.30 / lum) * 0.75
    sc.view_settings.exposure = base_exp + max(-1.0, min(2.2, gain))
    # final
    sc.render.resolution_percentage = 100
    try: ee.taa_render_samples = 16
    except Exception: pass
    ims.file_format = "JPEG"; ims.quality = 95
    sc.render.filepath = out
    bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
    print("STILL %d lum %.3f exp %+.2f %.1fs" % (f, lum, sc.view_settings.exposure, time.time() - t0), flush=True)

EOF_ST
ls -la stills.py

steps.run: [ -f ../2307-mc43-prev3/mc43.blend ] || exit 1; mkdir -p s; cp ../2315-mc43-stills/s/s*.jpg s/ 2>/dev/null; T=$(date +%s); export MC_FRAMES=20,255,300,425,560,660,750,1060,1440,2060; for i in $(seq 0 9); do t=$(date +%s); /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b ../2307-mc43-prev3/mc43.blend -P stills.py -- $PWD/s $i $i >> st.log 2>&1; echo still $i $(( $(date +%s)-t ))s; done; grep -e STILL -e Error -e rror st.log | grep -v -i bearer | tail -30; ls s/*.jpg | wc -l; echo stills_s $(( $(date +%s)-T ))
